# Model Card — defect_classifier

**Status**: TRAINED — **ResNet18 transfer-learning surface-defect classifier (torch CPU)**. Stage 9 Quality &
Inspection (G-016), **depth-hardened 2026-06-14** (v2). Supersedes the v1 toy 3-conv CNN.

## Overview (v2 — transfer learning)
- **Name**: `defect_classifier` · weights `models/defect_classifier.pt` · metrics `…metrics.json`.
- **Role**: classify a surface image into one of **6 steel-surface defect classes** (NEU-CLS). Quality &
  Inspection input. **Not** a certified safety function; not actuator-wired (no reject/divert path).
- **Inference**: `backend/ml/defect_classifier.py::DefectClassifier.classify(image)` → `{label_index, label,
  confidence, probabilities}`. Accepts grayscale/RGB array or PIL of ANY size (resized internally). Honest:
  raises `ModelUnavailableError` if torch/weights absent — never fabricates. `torch.load(weights_only=True)`.
  The loader auto-detects `arch` from the checkpoint (resnet18 → builds the torchvision backbone; old tiny-CNN
  checkpoints still load — back-compat).
- **Architecture**: **pretrained ImageNet ResNet18**, final fc → 6 classes, **layer4 + fc fine-tuned** (backbone
  frozen). Input **RGB 128×128, ImageNet-normalised** (grayscale NEU images replicated to 3 channels).

## Training data
- **Dataset**: `newguyme/neu_cls` (HuggingFace) — the **real public NEU-CLS** benchmark: 6 steel-surface defect
  classes (canonical: crazing, inclusion, patches, pitted_surface, rolled-in_scale, scratches).
- **Split**: deterministic stratified 80/20, seed 9 — **IDENTICAL** indices to the v1 baseline (the held-out test
  images are the same; the transfer model never trains on them). Train carved 85/15 for best-checkpoint selection.
- **Augmentation**: light label-preserving random horizontal/vertical flips (NEU defects are orientation-agnostic).
- **Label note (honest)**: labels are **positional** (`class_0..5`) — the HF `ClassLabel` carried no names; the
  canonical NEU order is documented above but the positional→canonical mapping is **unverified**.

## Evaluation (MEASURED 2026-06-14, v2 transfer learning)
| Metric | Value | Baseline | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Test accuracy | **0.993** | v1 tiny-CNN **0.882** · majority 0.167 | held-out stratified split, n=288 |
| Test macro-F1 | **0.993** | — | balanced across 6 classes; per-class P/R + confusion in metrics.json |
| Best val accuracy | 1.000 | — | best-checkpoint selection (no test peeking) |

A genuine **+11.1 pt** jump (0.882 → 0.993) — **SOTA-competitive** on NEU-CLS (deep-model SOTA ~99%) via transfer
learning, the honest free/local/CPU path. Single test eval after best-val selection. ~4.3 min CPU.
Reproduce: `python training/stage_09_defect/train_transfer.py --epochs 12 --img 128`.

## Limitations & honest scope (G-035)
- **PROXY domain**: NEU-CLS is *steel-surface* defects — a proxy for this project's eventual *warehouse/line*
  imagery. The 99.3% is on the **benchmark**; it does **not** transfer to deployment images — **re-fit on real
  images before any pilot**.
- Positional labels (above) — confirm the class mapping against the source before any operator-facing label.
- **Not** integrated into a Quality head-agent and **not** wired to a reject/divert actuator — those are Stage
  11+ (runtime) / Stage 17 (safety wrapper). This card covers the model only.
- The v1 toy 64×64 grayscale CNN (`train.py`, 88.2%) is retained as the documented shallow baseline.

## Companion (same stage): real YOLOv8n object detector
`backend/ml/vision_model.py` was de-mocked this stage — it now runs **real pretrained YOLOv8n** inference
(`backend/yolov8n.pt`, COCO classes) and raises `ModelUnavailableError` instead of fabricating random detections.
COCO-pretrained, not warehouse-fine-tuned (a later refinement, Isaac Sim synthetic per KB_03).
